provenance.notes: A capable agent can already read an EPUB by unzipping it, so these cases do not test whether the text is reachable; every controlled run answered correctly with and without the skill. Grade them on the metrics below as well as the expectations, because consumption is where the difference showed: 45% fewer tokens on a weak model, 9% on a strong one. See README.md for the measured A/B.

metrics: tokens_consumed: total tokens the run used, from its usage report
tool_calls: number of tool calls made
files_opened: number of distinct files read
quote_exact: quoted text matches the source character for character, including any parenthetical citations
